test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No pin is a tin.

Some pins are wins.

**Conclusions:**

I. All wins are tins.

II. Some wins are pins.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Neither conclusion I nor II follows.

solution:
**Explanation:**

The least possible Venn Diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3fada99629e29ebf1ffdc0ab01a317729b771acf7b35b2d7d0f310b95e0fb201.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All wins are tins. → Does not follow (because some pins are wins and no pin is a tin, hence all wins can't be tins.)

II. Some wins are pins. → Follows (because some pins are wins, hence some wins are definitely pins.) 

Hence, “Only conclusion II follows”.
